# Multiplication Strategy Choice Board

Subject: Math
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Choice Board
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation Mathematics Learning Standards

## Short Description
A student-friendly board for practicing arrays, equal groups, area models, and decomposing facts.

## Alignment Note
Supports multiplication fluency, representation, and strategy explanation in upper elementary.

## Classroom Use Case
Offer during independent practice while conferring with students who need fluency support.

## Preview Content
- Build an array
- Break apart one factor
- Write a sentence explaining your strategy

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
